headline.purpose: Page titles at 24–28px with bold weight and compact tracking.

body.purpose: Thai-first operational copy, form labels, table content, and supporting metadata.

label.purpose: Readable 11–12px labels, status text, table headers, and secondary details.

shadows.name: soft-separation
shadows.purpose: Use only where a dialog or elevated layer needs separation from the operational canvas.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Navigation, button, and progress state changes; respect reduced-motion preferences.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The primary commit action for a page or form.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-primary">บันทึกรายการ</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; background: var(--primary, #008BF8); color: #fff; font: 600 12px 'Noto Sans Thai Variable', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 200ms ease, transform 200ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--primary-hover, #0075D1); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgb(0 139 248 / 35%); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: A compact search field used above operational data lists.
components.css: .ds-search { display: grid; gap: 6px; color: #172033; font: 600 11px 'Noto Sans Thai Variable', sans-serif; } .ds-search input { height: 40px; min-width: 240px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid #E4EAF2; border-radius: 10px; background: #fff; color: #172033; font: 400 12px 'Noto Sans Thai Variable', sans-serif; } .ds-search input::placeholder { color: #94A3B8; } .ds-search input:focus { border-color: #008BF8; outline: 3px solid rgb(0 139 248 / 16%); outline-offset: 0; }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: Text-labelled semantic state that never relies on color alone.
components.html: บันทึกแล้ว
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 24px; padding: 2px 10px; border-radius: 999px; background: #E8F7EF; color: #16845B; font: 600 11px/1.4 'Noto Sans Thai Variable', sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Operational Card
components.description: Flat, bordered content surface for tables, summaries, and workflow panels.
components.html:
รายการที่ต้องดำเนินการ

สรุปข้อมูลที่เกี่ยวข้องกับงานถัดไป
components.css: .ds-card { padding: 20px; border: 1px solid #E4EAF2; border-radius: 16px; background: #fff; color: #172033; font-family: 'Noto Sans Thai Variable', sans-serif; } .ds-card h3 { margin: 0; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.4; } .ds-card p { margin: 6px 0 0; color: #64748B; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.5; }

components.name: Sidebar Navigation Item
components.description: Persistent desktop navigation with a restrained blue active state.
components.html: ภาพรวม
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; min-height: 40px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 10px; color: #475569; font: 500 13px 'Noto Sans Thai Variable', sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: background 200ms ease, color 200ms ease; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: #F8FAFC; color: #172033; } .ds-nav-item-active { background: #EAF5FF; color: #0075D1; } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgb(0 139 248 / 35%); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
A restrained, Thai-first operations workspace for village staff. The interface makes record lookup, financial status, water service actions, and traceable next steps feel dependable rather than ornamental.

Density is compact enough for office workflows while mobile layouts turn wide records into readable stacked content. Blue signals the route to action; semantic colors explain state and never stand alone.

rules.name: One Action Rule
rules.body: Use the primary blue for the most important action or active state; do not use it as decoration on every element.

rules.name: Readable Record Rule
rules.body: Mobile records stack and wrap meaningful values instead of hiding them behind truncation or horizontal scrolling.

rules.name: Flat-First Rule
rules.body: Use borders and tonal surfaces by default. Reserve shadows for dialogs and layers that need separation.

dos: Do use the canonical CSS variables from src/app/globals.css.
Do pair semantic color with readable status text or an icon.
Do preserve visible focus and keyboard operation.
Do keep primary touch targets at least 40px high.
donts: Don't use blue as decoration on every element.
Don't shrink essential Thai labels below readable sizes on mobile.
Don't force wide data tables into horizontal scrolling on mobile.
Don't use alert dialogs for ordinary field validation.
